newsitem.title: UK: Baldwin sees results below expectations.
newsitem.headline: Baldwin sees results below expectations.

text.p: British diversified business group Baldwin Plc said on Thursday its results for the year ended October 31, 1996 would be below market expectations after it suffered losses on book value on disposal of investments.
In a statement, the company said it had suffered a book loss of 0.234 million stg after it disposed its investment in Old Brompton Road, London, for a cash consideration 1.32 million stg.
Baldwin also wrote down the value of its five percent investment in Greenhills Plc to nil thereby suffering a book value loss of 300,000 stg, it said.
"As a result of these exceptional matters, the directors consider that the company's results for the year ended 31 October, 1996 will accordingly be below market expectations," it said.
The share price reacted to the gloomy outlook by falling 22.5 pence to 107.5 from Wednesday's close of 130p.
Baldwin is involved in publishing, restaurants, tour operation and property.
